nirspecBackgroundNote: Luhman (2025) classified seven JuMBO components observed with JWST/NIRSpec (program 2770) as background stars: they lack the H2O bands of young brown dwarfs. Three are named in the text (6NW, 10SE, 11NW). Four further IDs appear only in Figure 1 of that paper, so this engine marks the named three as spectroscopic background and the remaining systems as photometry-only.

opticalSpectra.note: Unresolved 0.1 arcsec pair. If an ONC member, evolutionary models give ~0.1 solar masses — a star, not a Jupiter-mass binary.
Primary classified M8. At ONC age that is ~0.04 solar masses — a brown dwarf, not a JuMBO.

radio.note: Only JuMBO with a published VLA radio counterpart. Proper-motion upper limit ~6 km/s, consistent with a star-forming core rather than a fast ejection. Radio origin still uncertain.
